product_metadata.title: Edsal 48"W x 24"D x 72"H 5-Shelf Steel Shelving, Black
features: Z beam construction for strength and rigidity
Assembles in minutes with just a hammer (no nuts or bolts required)
Weight capacity: up to 4000 lbs distributed evenly over the entire unit (Holds 800 lbs per shelf)
Shelves adjust every 1-1/2" and have a durable black finish
description: Store and organize your items with this 48"W x 24"D x 72"H Edsal Steel Shelving Unit. This Black Steel Shelving Unit features a Z beam construction for added strength and rigidity, so that these shelves will be able to handle lots of weight. The five shelves are made of particle board and are specifically designed to support heavy loads. These shelves can also be adjusted every inch and a half, so you can assemble and adjust the 5-Shelf Edsal Heavy Duty Shelving to fit your needs. This shelving storage unit can hold up to 4000 lbs as long as the weight is distributed evenly over the entire unit. The 48"W x 24"D x 72"H Edsal Steel Shelving Unit is ideal for storing tools and other heavy equipment in the garage, tool shed or even your greenhouse. Holds 800 lbs per shelf; 4000 lbs total
